QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Muscat-2000's Thoughtfulness
QuestInfo.0: Without a heart, #p2154007# stops functioning. To save him, you need the new heart that #p2154003# made. Go to #b#m310050100##k and see #b#p2154003##k.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2154003# gave you the heart that he made with his own two hands. He says it lacks energy, because it wasn't made by #p2154009#. Due to its energy inefficiency, you need to take it to #b#p2154007##k after charging enough energy. Like an Energy Cartridge, #bthe energy seems to charge when you hunt enemies#k. 

#rDouble-click the Energy Cartridge#k in the #bEtc tab#k to fill it with energy.
QuestInfo.2: After receiving a new heart, #p2154007# opened his eyes. The #o8105003# siblings, who can't feel any emotions, truly had a strong sibling bond.

demand.base: #questorder1#Earn EXP by hunting to fill the cartridge

0.conditionContent: Earn EXP by hunting to fill the cartridge

0.0: I received the transmission sent by #p2154007# before his functions were disrupted. Thank you for helping my siblings. Thanks to you, both of them have been saved. I believe you are what people mean by the word 'kindness.'\r\n#L0# #bDid you know that this would happen?#l\n#k
0.1: I knew that a day would come when Doctor #p2154009# would abandon #p2154012#. Amongst all of us, #p2154012# was designed specifically for combat. However, that means his energy consumption was the highest. I knew that #p2154012# would be the first to be abandoned.\r\n#L0# #bThen why did you make #t4032774# instead of #p2154012#'s heart?#l\n#k
0.2: I am not capable of recreating a #p2154009# type heart perfectly. Had I made #p2154012#'s heart, the output would be insufficient when #p2154012# was called into combat. Since #p2154007# is not designed for combat, the heart that I made should be sufficient.\r\n#L0# #b(#p2154003# appears to have put a lot of thought into this.)#l\n#k
0.3: However, even with #p2154007# using it, the heart I made doesn't have high energy efficiency. Ergo, the energy needs to be charged in advance. Charge the energy while delivering the heart to #p2154007#. I trust that you will be able to help us.

yes.0: You can fill it by hunting monsters the same way you did with the Energy Cartridge. Please charge the energy to 100% and deliver it to #p2154007#. Thank you.

no.0: #p2154007# was never afraid even as his functions became disrupted. It was possibly because he trusted you.

1.0: #b(You see the inoperable #p2154007#. Place the new heart where the old heart used to be and press the button to turn #p2154007# back on.)#k

yes.0: It is wonderful to see you again, #h0#. Without you, our plans would never have been successful. Although #p2154012# won't express it I know that deep inside she also appreciates all that you've done.

npc.0: Have you not gone to #p2154007#? Please #bcharge the #t4032774# by hunting monsters and then put in inside #p2154007##k.

item.0: (You see the inoperable #p2154007#. It seems that a new heart is required to turn on #p2154007#.)
